title: MissionOutcome
description: The root of mission-outcome.json: the latest mission as it ended, written again once its salvage is final.

modVersion.description: The four-part version of the mod that wrote the file; the other files match the catalog written by the same version.

exportedAt.description: When the file was last changed.

trigger.description: What caused the export that last changed the file.

contract.description: The contract the mission was for.

state.description: Whether the contract was completed, retreated from or failed.

isGoodFaithEffort.description: Whether a retreated or failed contract still counts as a good faith effort, which softens its penalties.

rounds.description: The combat rounds the mission took, counted from 1.

objectives.description: The objectives as the after-action report lists them.

payment.description: The C-Bills paid, with the good faith modifier and the bonuses applied.

reputation.description: The final reputation changes with the employer and the target.

mercenaryReviewBoardReputation.description: The change of the Mercenary Review Board rating.

experiencePerPilot.description: The experience every pilot of lance gets.

lance.description: The company's mechs and pilots on the mission, in lance order.

salvage.description: The salvage offer, and what the company got once it is final.

MissionContract.description: The contract a mission was for.

id.description: The contract's data file; null where the game keeps no reference to it.

name.description: The contract's name, as the contract list shows it.

type.description: The mission type, described in contractTypes.

displayStyle.description: Whether it's a regular, story, restoration or flashpoint contract.

employer.description: The faction that hires the company.

target.description: The faction the mission is fought against.

difficulty.description: On the scale of maxContractDifficulty, not the 1-10 the skulls show (two per skull).

starSystem.description: The star system the mission is fought in, the current one, in full, as in star-systems.json.

DefinitionReference.description: A game definition: its id from the game's data files and the name shown in the UI.

id.description: The id it's referred to by: for a definition its id from the game's data files, for a mech in the mech bay or a pilot the game's own id of it.

StarSystem.description: A star system with its active definition and its career state. The story swaps some star systems' definitions (e.g. to change their owner); the id and what the definition holds are the active one's.

id.description: The active definition's id, as in the references to the star system.

name.description: The name, as in the references to the star system.

owner.description: The faction that owns the star system.

tags.description: The star system's tags, as its starmap panel shows them.

biomes.description: The biomes the star system's missions can be on.

maps.description: The maps the star system's contracts can be fought on, as the contract generator selects them from its biomes and map tags; each map's terrain is in the catalog's mapDefinitions.

difficulty.description: The star system's difficulty, as the starmap shows it.

canTravelTo.description: Whether the star system's travel requirements are met; story systems stay locked until then.

route.description: The trip from the current star system; null where the game finds no route, always while canTravelTo is false.

Route.description: The trip from the current star system, as the starmap plans and shows it.

days.description: The days the trip takes; 0 for the current star system.

cost.description: The C-Bills the trip costs; 0 for the current star system.

ObjectiveResult.description: An objective as the after-action report lists it.

title.description: The objective's title as plain text.

isPrimary.description: Whether the after-action report lists it as a primary objective.

status.description: The objective's game status, e.g. Succeeded, Failed, or Active for one left unresolved.

ReputationChange.description: The reputation changes of a contract: of its success, as the negotiation shows them, or of a mission's outcome.

employer.description: The change, usually a gain, with the employer; null when the employer doesn't gain reputation.

target.description: The change, usually a loss, with the target; null when the target doesn't gain reputation.

LanceUnitOutcome.description: A mech and its pilot after the mission.

pilot.description: The pilot who fought in the mech.

injuries.description: The pilot's injuries, including those from before the mission.

health.description: The injuries the pilot can take before being incapacitated.

isIncapacitated.description: Whether the pilot was incapacitated: injuries reached health, or a lethal injury such as the mech's head destroyed.

isKilled.description: Whether the pilot died; an incapacitated pilot may survive.

pilotReadyOnDay.description: The day the pilot is out of the med bay, as the barracks counts it once the contract is resolved; null for an uninjured or killed pilot.

mechKills.description: The enemy mechs the pilot destroyed in this mission.

otherKills.description: The other enemy units the pilot destroyed in this mission.

mech.description: The mech, as in the mech bay.

isMechLost.description: Whether the mech was destroyed and not recovered; its surviving components are in automatic.

repair.description: What repairing the mech's damage in the mech bay would take, as for a mech bay mech's repair; null without damage and for a lost mech.

damagedLocations.description: The locations that lost armor or structure, from head to legs.

ammunition.description: The shots fired from every ammo box and every weapon that carries its own ammo, in the mech's component order.

PilotReference.description: A pilot: their id, full name without callsign, and callsign.

id.description: The id it's referred to by: for a definition its id from the game's data files, for a mech in the mech bay or a pilot the game's own id of it.

callsign.description: The pilot's callsign, which isn't part of name.

MechReference.description: A mech in the mech bay: its own id, as in id, and its chassis name with the variant.

id.description: The id it's referred to by: for a definition its id from the game's data files, for a mech in the mech bay or a pilot the game's own id of it.

RepairEstimate.description: What the mech bay's Repair would take if ordered now, as its confirmation shows it.

days.description: The days the mech lab needs for the repair alone; it works on one order at a time, so an order queued behind others finishes later.

armor.description: The front armor, or the only armor outside the torso.

rearArmor.description: null outside the torso, which alone has rear armor.

structure.description: The structure left: below the chassis' when damaged, zero when destroyed.

current.description: What is left after combat damage; refilled to assigned after a mission unless the location was destroyed.

assigned.description: The armor fitted in the mech lab.

component.description: The component, by the id its definition is keyed by.

location.description: The location it is mounted in.

damageLevel.description: The game's damage level, e.g. Penalized or Destroyed.

ComponentReference.description: A component's definition, like DefinitionReference, with the type that tells which group of componentDefinitions holds it. Components compare by type first, then as every reference.

id.description: The id it's referred to by: for a definition its id from the game's data files, for a mech in the mech bay or a pilot the game's own id of it.

type.description: The game's component type, e.g. Weapon or AmmunitionBox, which names the component's group in componentDefinitions.

AmmunitionUse.description: The shots a mech fired from an ammo box, or from a weapon that carries its own ammo.

component.description: The component, by the id its definition is keyed by.

location.description: The location the box or weapon is mounted in.

used.description: The shots fired, also from a box destroyed since; the capacity is the catalog's capacity or internalAmmoCapacity.

MissionSalvage.description: The salvage of the mission: the offer as the mission ended, and what the company got once it is final.

total.description: How many items of pool the company gets.

priority.description: How many of them the company picks itself; the rest are drawn at random from what is left.

automatic.description: The surviving components of the company's own lost mechs, which it gets back on top of total.

received.description: Everything the company gets: the priority salvage, the salvage drawn at random and automatic; null until the salvage is final.

SalvageItems.description: Salvage items, counted like Storage, where they end up.

components.description: Their damagedCount is 0: the game generates no damaged salvage.

mechParts.description: The mech parts, by the mech they assemble into.

component.description: The component, by the id its definition is keyed by.

count.description: The working copies; the damaged ones are in damagedCount.

damagedCount.description: The damaged copies, which need a repair once mounted.

mech.description: The mech the parts assemble into, described in mechDefinitions.
